the buffer next. it flushes every 10 seconds, which is far too lazy for what we're doing. take it to 5. and the max is 4MB, double that.

retention. 90 days is absurd for what we pay for that volume. 30.

run everything.

steers.text: anyway. the index.

the http source retries. what does it do now?
use a token bucket, not exponential backoff. backoff hides the pressure and then the whole lot arrives at once the moment it clears. 175 a second.

keep going. the matching half first, dispatch after.
dispatch timeout is 30 seconds. that's a stuck thread for half a minute every time a webhook goes dark. 10.
and no new runtime dependencies without asking me first. devDependencies I don't care about.
run everything, I want to see the router tests green before we move.
the index is single-shard, which is why the p99 is what it is. six.
